question: During The Battle of Chanderi or Siege of Chanderi, the Mughal Emperor ______ had defeated Rajputs in 1528.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Babur.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__**Battle of Chanderi: 1528**__

__
 
• The Battle of Chanderi was dated on **20 January 1528.**
 
• This battle was fought between the **Mughal Emperor Babur and the Rajput Confederacy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**__**Battle of Chanderi(1528):**__

 
• Babur was firmly established in India and his** centre of power shifted from Kabul to Delhi **after the battle of Khanwa.
 
• **Chanderi **was situated on the** border of Malwa and Bundelkhand** and therefore, was important both politically and economically.
 
• Besides, it was now in the hands of a **Rajput chief, Medini Rai** who had freed himself from the sovereignty of the ruler of Malwa.
 
• Babur decided to destroy his power and therefore, demanded **Chanderi in exchange for Shamsabad.**
 
• It was refused and Babur attacked Chanderi on 29 January 1528 A.D.
 
• **Medini Rai was killed** in the battle and the fort of Chanderi was captured by Babur.
 
• However, it was handed over to **Ahmad Shah,** a descendant of the ruling dynasty of Malwa.
